description: storeOrder has one production caller, but owns the transaction that keeps order creation and stock reservation atomic. Inlining database operations at that caller removes a meaningful domain boundary. One caller is not a defect. This is a synthetic clean control.

prContext.title: orders: save the order and reserve stock atomically
prContext.description: The order handler now delegates persistence to storeOrder. The database transaction covers both the order row and its stock reservation, so a failure rolls both operations back.
